title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Regularizing the Intercept
text: Regularizing the intercept term means adding a penalty to the intercept in the ridge regression formula. This can affect the model's bias and variance.

title: Comparing Models with and without Regularized Intercept
text: When the data is mean-centered, the intercept term does not contribute to the prediction error, as the mean of the centered data is zero. This can lead to the models being equivalent.

hintAnswer: Mean-centering makes the intercept term irrelevant in terms of regularization as it does not affect the prediction error.
